exact_claims.natural_statement: Deleting a uniform q from a uniform t-subset B of P gives a uniform (t-1)-subset U; conditional on U, q is uniform in P\U. The deletion incidence graph has left degree n-t+1 and right degree t.
exact_claims.hypotheses: Finite pool of n distinct labels, 1<=t<=n, uniform B and uniform q conditional on B; no conditioning on stability
exact_claims.assessment: Supported by the exact incidence bijection and edge counts; not encoded as a concrete Lean sampler theorem

exact_claims.natural_statement: For positive ell,T with ell+T-1<=n, uniform t in ell..ell+T-1, uniform t-subset B and uniform q in B, E[1_{q|m(B)}] <= (F(ell-1)-F(ell+T-1))/T + (D/T) sum_{t=ell}^{ell+T-1}1/(n-t+1) <= (B0-1)/T + D/(n-ell-T+2), without independence between B and m(B).
exact_claims.assessment: Human proof supported with explicit positive-integer B0; generic Lean core does not itself state the concrete sampling theorem or the sharper harmonic-sum conclusion

finite_theorem_hypotheses: P is a finite set of n distinct primes
B0 is a positive integer and D a nonnegative integer in the normalized statement; B0 typing is implicit rather than explicit in the scoped draft header
R(U) is an integer with 0<=R(U)<B0 on all required levels
m(U) is a nonzero integer on those levels
R(U union {q})<=R(U) on each deletion edge
Equality of records on an edge implies equality of the corresponding integers
At most D primes in P divide each m(U)
ell,T are positive integers and ell+T-1<=n
t is uniform on the T consecutive sizes; B is uniform conditional on t; q is uniform conditional on B

formal_core.bad: For q,m in Z, bad(q,m) in Q equals 1 if q divides m and 0 otherwise
formal_core.adaptive_edge_bound: Natural before,after and integer old,new,q; after<=before and (before=after implies old=new) imply bad(q,new)<=(before:Q)-after+bad(q,old)
formal_core.regular_deletion_step: Finite U,V, decidable edge relation, natural rank functions, integer minor functions and labels, natural c,d,D; row degrees c, column degrees d, edge rank monotonicity, equal-rank equal-minor stability, and at most D incident old-divisor edges per lower vertex imply sum of full-divisor edge indicators <= c*sum(lowerRank)-d*sum(upperRank)+card(U)*D
formal_core.telescope: For all F:N->Q and T:N, sum(k<T,F(k)-F(k+1))=F(0)-F(T)
formal_core.averaged_deletion_bound: For F,A,denominator:N->Q, T:N positive, B,D,c:Q with c>0 and D>=0, c<=denominator(k) for k<T, F(0)-F(T)<=B and A(k)<=F(k)-F(k+1)+D/denominator(k) imply sum(k<T,A(k))/T<=B/T+D/c
formal_core.finite_pool_average_bound: For natural n,ell,T with ell,T>0 and ell+T<=n+1, F,A:N->Q, B,D:Q with D>=0, supplied span F(0)-F(T)<=B and supplied steps A(k)<=F(k)-F(k+1)+D/((n+1-ell-k:N):Q) for k<T imply sum(k<T,A(k))/T<=B/T+D/((n+2-ell-T:N):Q)
